description: What is trending right now: Hacker News top stories, GitHub trending repositories (stars today/week/month), most-read Wikipedia articles (any language edition), Google News top stories per country, Baidu realtime hot searches and Bilibili popular videos (China). Each item has rank, title, url and a score (points, stars, pageviews, heat, views). Params: sources (default all), limit per source (1 to 50, default 10), language (Wikipedia and Google News, default en), country (Google News, default US), since (GitHub: daily, weekly, monthly). Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"sources":["hackernews","github","wikipedia"],"limit":5}.
name: trends_hot
title: Trending Now (hot lists)
